# Community conduct

Treat contributors and users respectfully. Focus criticism on ideas and behavior, explain disagreements with evidence, and make room for people with different experience levels.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory abuse, publishing private information, and spam are not welcome. Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and restrict participation when needed to protect the community.

For a private conduct concern, contact Chester Hill Solutions at info@chsolutions.ca. For vulnerabilities, use the separate [security reporting process](SECURITY.md).
